title: Figure 11. DNA nanomotifs with AFM and fluorescence microscopy images of 2D DNA crystals
description: Six-panel figure: (a) a symmetric cross DNA motif and (d) a three-point-star motif drawn schematically; (b) and (e) atomic force micrographs showing square and hexagonal crystal lattices with nm scale axes; (c) and (f) green fluorescence microscopy images of DNA 2D crystals with 200 μm scale bars. Captioned "Figure 11. Two symmetric DNA nanomotifs and the crystals grown using them."
